children: Bath & Body Works granted Chief Executive Officer Daniel Heaf a performance stock unit award with a $10 million target value to incentivize long-term strategy execution.
To further incentivize leadership focus on executing long-term strategy and creating sustained shareholder value

PSU target value $10 million (591,366 shares); earned based on four stock price goals over four-year period; vesting on fourth anniversary subject to continued employment; potential reduction based on relative TSR vs. S&P 1500 Consumer Discretionary Distribution & Retail Index
